HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Stories and Family Values? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scriptural Stories and Family Values has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Stories and Family Values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Scriptural Stories and Family Values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Friendship and Keeping Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Say Friendship and Keeping Promises has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Friendship and Keeping Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Friendship and Keeping Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Friendship and Keeping Promises.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Physical Aspect of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical Aspect of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical Aspect of Yoga.
   C. Use Physical Aspect of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Physical Aspect of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Medicinal Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Use Medicinal Trees to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Medicinal Trees has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Medicinal Trees.
   D. Apply the teaching of Medicinal Trees with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Which response best shows understanding of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.
   D. Apply the teaching of Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
